page.layout: One bound spine, vertical; at the top a handwritten manuscript label, at the bottom a printed library shelf-mark label. Neither is printed text on the page.
page.notes: Image shows the spine of a vellum-bound volume, not a printed page. Top: handwritten manuscript label in ink, reading "Zachariae Ursini / Corpus Doctrinae / et Davidis Parei / Miscellanea Catechet. / Genevae 1616". This is handwriting, so it is not transcribed.
